zh-CN: 改善 AI 流式响应与 CLI 输出兼容性，保留完整生成内容，并提供更明确的服务端错误提示。
优化 AI 输入输出预算及提交拆分截断后的重试，切换仓库或所选文件时避免旧生成结果覆盖当前提交草稿。
输出与日志新增 AI 通道，可查看请求阶段、预算、耗时及脱敏错误详情，便于排查生成失败。
优化新窗口启动时的主题与显示时机，初始化失败时仍显示应用界面和错误提示。
完善 Linux 标签拖拽预览，调整预览位置与样式，并在 Windows 和 Linux 上显示标签分离徽标。
改善 macOS 更新后的应用重启，支持带空格和中文的安装路径，并通过系统启动更新后的应用。
en: Improve compatibility with AI streaming responses and CLI output, preserving complete generated content and showing clearer server errors.

Improve AI input and output budgets and retries for truncated commit-splitting results, preventing stale generations from overwriting the current commit draft when switching repositories or selected files.
Add an AI channel to Output and Logs for request stages, budgets, timing and redacted error details to help diagnose generation failures.
Improve startup theme and visibility handling for new windows, keeping the application interface and error messages visible if initialization fails.
Improve tab drag previews on Linux, adjust preview placement and styling, and show a tab-detachment badge on Windows and Linux.
Improve application restarts after updates on macOS, supporting installation paths with spaces and Chinese characters and launching the updated app through the system.

zh-CN: GitHub、GitLab 和 Gitee 账号详情及状态栏提示支持展示平台头像，并提供缓存和加载失败回退。
作者头像优先使用当前分支跟踪的远程仓库，修复多远程仓库和切换账号时头像来源或显示不正确的问题。
托管平台的认证、权限、限流和网络错误提供中英文提示，便于识别失败原因。
分支侧栏支持点击分区标题空白和计数区域展开或折叠，创建标签按钮在悬停或键盘聚焦时显示。
调整差异视图新增和删除行的行号背景色，便于区分变更类型。
改进 GitCode 镜像安装包上传及失败重试，提升备用下载源的发布稳定性。
en: Show platform avatars in GitHub, GitLab and Gitee account details and status bar tooltips, with caching and a fallback when loading fails.
Prefer the current branch's tracked remote for author avatars, fixing incorrect avatar sources or displays with multiple remotes and when switching accounts.
Provide Chinese and English messages for hosting platform authentication, permission, rate limit and network errors.
Expand or collapse branch sidebar sections by clicking empty space or counts in their headers, and show the create-tag button on hover or keyboard focus.
Adjust line-number backgrounds for added and deleted lines in diff views to make change types easier to distinguish.
Improve GitCode mirror installer uploads and failure retries for more reliable publishing of the fallback download source.

zh-CN: 命令超时或取消时保留已输出的错误详情，工作区更新失败提示提供更完整的原因，便于排查网络和认证问题。
优化差异和源码视图的语法高亮，通过后台处理与缓存减少重复计算，切换文件或主题时避免显示过期高亮。
修复应用窗口标题为空的问题，统一显示 VersionDock Desktop。
备用更新源切换为 GitCode，并改进安装包发布与校验流程，镜像发布失败时不阻断 GitHub 主更新源发布。
en: Preserve available error details when commands time out or are cancelled, and show more complete workspace update failures to help diagnose network and authentication issues.
Improve syntax highlighting in diff and source views with background processing and caching, reducing repeated work and preventing stale highlights when switching files or themes.
Fix empty application window titles and consistently display VersionDock Desktop.
Switch the fallback update source to GitCode and improve installer publishing and verification, allowing GitHub releases to proceed independently of mirror publishing failures.

zh-CN: 变更列表支持按文件名和路径搜索、显示匹配数量并逐项定位，搜索时保留其他文件及原有提交勾选。
搜索结果高亮匹配文字并自动展开所在目录和分组，清除搜索后恢复原有折叠状态。
改善提交详情中的搜索定位和焦点恢复，支持快捷键打开搜索及切换匹配项，避免干扰工具栏按钮操作。
修正 GitHub 更新检查、安装包下载和问题反馈地址，统一指向当前公开项目仓库。
en: Search changes by file name or path, see match counts and navigate between matches while keeping other files visible and preserving commit selections.
Highlight matching text and automatically expand folders and groups containing results, restoring their previous collapsed state when search is cleared.
Improve search navigation and focus restoration in commit details, with shortcuts to open search and switch matches without interfering with toolbar buttons.
Correct GitHub update checks, installer downloads and issue links to use the current public project repository.

zh-CN: 完善 Git 标签创建、推送、删除、检出及合并流程，支持操作预检和多仓库选择。
更新提示显示对应版本的实际更新内容，更新日志支持中英文。
欢迎页不再显示工作区状态栏，避免检查更新时出现多余状态信息。
扫描工作区时跳过无权限访问的子目录；根目录无法访问时提供明确路径和权限提示。
en: Improve Git tag creation, push, deletion, checkout and merge workflows, with preflight checks and repository selection.
Show version-specific update details and release history in Chinese and English.
Keep the workspace status bar hidden on the welcome page during update checks.
Skip inaccessible subdirectories when scanning workspaces and show clear path and permission details for inaccessible roots.

zh-CN: 启动时、每 15 分钟及网络恢复时自动检查新版本。
优化更新下载重试与错误提示，下载失败时可切换到公司 GitLab 镜像。
状态栏直接显示更新操作，下载完成后提示重启安装。
改善 Windows 上 Git 工具的识别，减少已安装但无法使用的问题。
en: Check for updates on startup, every 15 minutes and when the network reconnects.
Improve download retries and errors, with a company GitLab mirror available when downloads fail.
Show update actions in the status bar and prompt to restart after downloading.
Improve Git detection on Windows when Git is installed but cannot be found.

zh-CN: 修复 macOS 从 Finder 启动时无法识别 Homebrew 或 MacPorts 安装的 SVN，导致检出按钮禁用的问题。
修复 SVN 在缺少语言环境时处理中文路径产生乱码的问题。
最近工作区中此前不可用的路径可点击重试，并显示原因提示。
en: Detect SVN installed through Homebrew or MacPorts when launched from Finder, restoring the checkout action.
Keep SVN paths in UTF-8 when the launch environment has no locale configured.
Allow retrying previously unavailable recent workspaces and explain their status.

zh-CN: 状态栏更新按钮直接开始下载和安装，更新完成后提示重启。
统一欢迎页、设置及关于窗口的版本显示。
改善更新按钮在浅色和深色主题下的可读性及中文翻译。
优化发布依赖缓存与桌面程序链接，减少重复构建。
en: Download and install directly from the status bar, with a restart prompt when ready.
Use consistent version information across the welcome page, settings and About dialog.
Improve update button contrast in light and dark themes and Chinese translations.
Reuse release dependency caches and reduce unnecessary desktop linking.

zh-CN: Windows 后台 Git 和 SVN 命令不再弹出终端窗口。
en: Run background Git and SVN commands on Windows without opening terminal windows.

zh-CN: 通过公开下载仓库提供 macOS 通用版、Windows x64 和 Linux x64 安装包及签名更新包。
修复文本差异中的二进制标记被误判为二进制文件的问题。
en: Distribute macOS universal, Windows x64 and Linux x64 installers and signed updates through the public download repository.
Keep binary-marker text in source diffs from being mistaken for binary files.

zh-CN: 🚀 VersionDock Desktop 首次发布
✨ 统一的 Git 与 Subversion（SVN）工作台
📑 多标签工作区管理，支持跨窗口拖放
🔍 可视化三方合并冲突编辑器与差异查看器
📦 原生搁置与暂存管理
🔄 自动获取、后台仓库扫描与智能状态栏
🎨 浅色、深色及跟随系统主题，可自定义界面字号
en: 🚀 Initial release of VersionDock Desktop
✨ Unified workbench for Git and Subversion (SVN)
📑 Multi-tab workspace management with cross-window drag & drop
🔍 Visual 3-way Merge Conflict Editor and Diff Viewer
📦 Native Shelve and Stash management
🔄 Auto-fetch, background repository scanning and smart status bar
🎨 Light / Dark / System theme and customizable UI font sizes
